title: Demo delivery
content: This is a demonstration. No products are physically dispatched. The original storefront described Lagos delivery in 1–3 business days and outside Lagos in 3–7 business days; these are illustrative, not a shipping commitment. Demo delivery fee is ₦0. No courier tracking, SMS or email is sent.

title: Demo returns
content: The original demo policy allows unopened products in original packaging within 7 days of delivery. Opened skincare is excluded unless damaged in transit. Report damage within 48 hours. In this demo, submit a support ticket; no physical return is processed.

title: Demo refunds
content: No money is collected, so no monetary refund can be issued. A refund request can be recorded as a support ticket. No real-world refund time frame is published.

title: Demo cancellation
content: Ask Lumi or use Contact to record a cancellation request. A request does not automatically change an order status. No real-world cancellation deadline is published.

title: Simulated payment only
content: Checkout creates a demo order with payment_status paid, payment_method simulated and order_status confirmed. No real money is charged. Do not enter card or bank details.

title: Demo data and privacy
content: Use fictional delivery details for this demo. Orders are accessible only from the browser session that created them, with the checkout email for order lookup. Losing the browser session requires support; email alone does not unlock an order. Lumi messages are sent to Google Gemini to answer your request. Do not share sensitive medical or payment information. Cart data stays in your browser. Support tickets and demo orders are saved in the configured database. No marketing emails are sent.
